t: Multi-focus hand torch delivers reliable lighting for home or commercial use. Control the beam for both short and long-distance lighting needs. Suitable for indoor or outdoor tasks and tight spaces. Offers 3 x brightness modes: 25% (150lm), 50% (300lm), and 100% (600lm). Adjustable head allows for easy switching between close and distance lighting. Equipped with a high-quality LED chip, to emit a cool white 6500K light, perfect for detailed work. The rechargeable 2200mAh Li-ion battery provides up to 5.5 hours of runtime, with built-in protection to prevent overcharging.
b: Battery Lasts up to 1 Hour 30 Mins
